name: Steam
notes: Windows Steam client, one per bottle. Install with `SteamSetup.exe /S`, then run C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\Steam.exe. -cef-disable-gpu is required on the wrapped arm64 runtime (wine 11.19): without it the window rendered at first, then went blank after switching between Library, Store and Community. With it, page switching worked in a manual test. Verified: silent install, bootstrap, login, page switching. Not verified: installing or launching a game, Steam Guard, long sessions. On runtime 0.2.0 (arm64-11.20-5) Steam also ran with an existing prefix; the window stays black for a short time at startup before it loads (observed by eye, not measured or compared with 0.1.0).
